name: Ava Recovery
move: commerce statistic assembles around a rising phone, glass message cards orbit the call, then a recovered-order notification releases oversized 100% typography
how: Compressed reconstruction of the reference film. Dark violet negative space, phone-depth moves, message-card parallax, notification payoff and huge masked typography are matched with deterministic CSS transforms.
adapt: Swap the metric, dialogue and phone content while preserving the depth hierarchy and long dark holds.
port: Scope phone/messages/type and drive the seek function from a shot timeline.
caveats: Generic phone UI replaces brand screenshots
